description: The .ocean/manifest.json storage shape extended so a repo's freshness cache is keyed per (repo, group): base mode gets its own distinct slot and each group gets its own, so changing one group's override invalidates only that group's cache. Cacheable ops (build/check/contain/publish) write their group slot; run and stop honor --group but write no slot. Feature #65, Unit: Core CLI, Interface: Lifecycle Command.

entities.name: CacheSlot
entities.description: One (repo, group) freshness slot holding the per-lifecycle-op hashes for that mode. The base slot and each group's slot are distinct, so a hash in one never satisfies a freshness check for another (#155, #156, #157). The slot is keyed by group; base mode uses a reserved distinct key. Requirements #155, #156, #157, #158, #159.

fields.name: group
fields.description: The group name this slot caches, or absent/reserved-base-key for base mode. The key that keeps a group's cache distinct from base and from every other group (#156).

fields.name: build_hash
fields.description: Hash of the resolved build command for this (repo, group). A matching hash skips the op as fresh (#158); a missing or mismatched hash rebuilds (#159).

entities.name: ManifestEntryGroups
entities.description: The additive extension to the existing ManifestEntry: alongside the existing top-level base hashes, a group-keyed map of CacheSlot so each deployment mode caches independently. Additive and backward-compatible — an entry with no group slots behaves as base-only, exactly as before. The base mode's hashes are its own distinct slot, never shared with any group (#156).

fields.name: base
fields.description: The base-mode slot (existing top-level build_hash/check_hash/contain_hash/publish_hash on ManifestEntry), modeled as the distinct base CacheSlot (#156).

fields.name: groups
fields.description: Per-group slots keyed by group name. Changing one group's override rewrites only that group's slot on the next op, leaving base and sibling groups untouched (#157).

entities.name: OverrideManifest
entities.description: The .ocean/manifest.json document: repo-key -> ManifestEntryGroups. Extends the existing Manifest.repos map. Requirements #155, #156, #157.

fields.name: repos
fields.description: Existing repo-keyed map; each entry now carries a base slot plus per-group slots.

operations.name: ReadGroupCacheSlot
operations.description: Read the CacheSlot for a (repo, GroupSelection) and compare its stored op hash against the hash of the resolved command to decide freshness: a match skips the op as fresh, a missing or mismatched hash triggers a rebuild. The base slot and each group slot are read by their own distinct key. Requirements #156, #158, #159.

out.name: fresh
out.description: True when the slot hash matches (skip), false when missing/mismatched (rebuild).

operations.name: WriteGroupCacheSlot
operations.description: After a cacheable op (build/check/contain/publish) completes under a GroupSelection, write the resolved command hash into that (repo, group) slot only, leaving base and sibling-group slots untouched. run and stop honor --group for resolution but write no slot. Requirements #155, #156, #157, #160, #161.

in.name: cacheable
in.description: False for run/stop, which resolve under --group but persist no slot (#160, #161).

out.name: slot
out.description: The written slot, or absent when the op is non-cacheable (run/stop).
